name: LensGuard
author: Shirak Semonian
description: Camera activity guard for the Omarchy bar: quietly watches which process holds /dev/video* open and clearly shows when the webcam is in use. Idle is calm, camera-in-use is unmistakable, and a tooltip names the process. Detects any app that opens the camera — including browsers, because PipeWire opens the device on their behalf. No service, no key, no network.

barWidget.description: Camera activity guard — shows when a process uses the webcam
